author: Gian López
abstract: An executable skill for creating and managing tasks in the Notion database "Control" through the Notion connector. It reads the live data-source schema before assigning dynamic catalog properties (Proyecto, Tipo, Módulo, Sprint), enforces workspace conventions for task naming and content style, replicates the database's default page template, and guards every write with a duplicate check and a mandatory preview-and-approval step. Behavior is governed by a set of user directives covering default values, always-confirmed fields, naming, tone, and the structure of the "Registros" progress log
